approximations: mitsuba: envmap rows resampled to v = j / (H - 1) because Mitsuba looks the map up at v * (H - 1) (corner-aligned rows; unfixed it reads the sun 0.15 degrees off and +0.4% bright on env-sphere).
mitsuba: material 'm0': base colour texture 't0' (1024x1024, sRGB, wrap clamp): bitmap bilinear, level 0 only

mitsuba: material 'm0': metallic-roughness texture: roughness alpha = (1 x G)^2 baked into a float PFM (bilinear in alpha, not in G: second-order difference), metalness 1 x B as the blendbsdf weight bitmap

mitsuba: material 'm0': dielectric over diffuse is roughplastic with nonlinear true (closed-form internal scattering); pbrt coateddiffuse is the stochastic layered reference and differs by a few percent

mitsuba: material 'm0': roughness texture on a dielectric over diffuse: 7 roughness levels (0, 42, 85, 128, 170, 212, 255) as a blendbsdf chain of plastics (roughplastic takes a float alpha), levels weighted by 0/1 bitmaps

mitsuba: material 'm0': textured conductor: eta 1 and k baked per texel from the base colour (PFM, raw), so bilinear filtering blends k rather than reflectance (differs from pbrt within one texel of an edge)
